recipes.name: STEAKHOUSE BURGER
ingredients: 85 g unsalted butter, cubed + very soft (~75 80 °F)
20 oz dry aged ribeye steak, ground
As needed freshly ground black pepper
instructions: For the Caramelized Onion
In a large skillet, add the olive oil and heat over medium heat. - 1 tbsp olive oil
Add the onions and reduce the heat to medium-low. - 2 yellow onions thinly sliced
Cook for 45 minutes - 1 hour or until the onions are completely tender and evenly caramelized. Stir periodically and add water if the bottom of the pan starts to scorch. - As needed water
Reserve until ready to use.
For the Hamburger Buns
Combine the flour, yeast, and sugar in the bowl of a stand mixer. - 500 g bread flour - 7 g instant dry yeast - 25 g granulated sugar
Evenly combine the dry ingredients using a whisk or fork.

Add the milk, water, and salt to the bowl. With the mixer fitted with a dough hook attachment, combine the dough on medium low speed until almost homogeneous. - 100 g whole milk warm (~85 °F) - 200 g water warm (~85 °F) - 10 g kosher salt

Begin adding the butter, one cube at a time and waiting until each cube is incorporated before adding another one, until all of the butter has been added. - 85 g unsalted butter cubed + very soft (~75 80 °F)
Increase the speed to medium-high and mix until the dough is smooth, elastic, and clears the sides of the bowl, about 6-8 minutes.
Transfer the dough to a large greased bowl and cover it with a clean dish towel or plate. - As needed cooking olive oil
Let the dough proof until about doubled in size, about 1-2 hours depending on the warmth of the room.
Remove the dough from the bowl and place it on a lightly oiled work surface. Divide and shape the dough into 6 even buns. Transfer the buns to a parchment-lined sheet tray.
Loosely over the buns, and allow the dough to proof for another 45 minutes - 1 hour, until puffed.
Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 350°F.
Once risen, brush the buns with the egg wash and sprinkle them with sesame seeds. - Egg wash (see below) - White sesame seeds
Bake the buns for 30-35 minutes, turning halfway through, until the dough is cooked through (200-205°F) and golden brown on top.
Allow the buns to cool completely before slicing.
For the Egg Wash
Combine all the egg wash ingredients in a small bowl. Whisk until well combined. - 1 egg - 1 egg yolk - pinch of salt
Reserve until ready to use.
For the Steakhouse Burger
Combine the ground ribeye and brisket in a large bowl. - 20 oz dry aged ribeye steak ground - 20 oz brisket ground
Form four 10 oz patties.
Preheat the grill over high heat and just before adding the patties, season them generously with salt and pepper. - As needed kosher salt - As needed freshly ground black pepper

Add the patties to the grill and cook on one side until well browned. Flip the burgers and add 1 slice of muenster cheese to each patty. Cook until well browned on the other side and the burgers have reached your desired doneness. - 4 sliced Muenster cheese
Meanwhile, add the buns to the grill and cook until well toasted, about 3-4 minutes. - 4 homemade hamburger buns sliced
Remove the burgers and buns from the grill.
Build the burgers and spread the caramelized onions on the top bun of each burger. - Reserved caramelized onions
Serve immediately.
